'''Tyloor''' was a [[Kedorzhan]] who was one of the seven [[Youngling/Legends|children]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]], [[Dewell Bronk]]. Tyloor [[Death/Legends|gave]] his life fighting for the Republic in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Inc" /> a conflict between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> which lasted from [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] until [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> After his death, his body was not recovered from the battlefield where he fell. The loss of his child was one of the factors which drove Dewell to sign the [[Petition of 2000]], a document condemning the actions of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] during the war.<ref name="Inc" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tyloor Bronk was mentioned in "[[Incognito]]," a short story written by [[John Jackson Miller]] and published in the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine's [[Star Wars Insider 143|143rd issue]]<ref name="Inc" /> on [[July 23]], [[2013]].<ref name="InsiderDate">{{TitanMagazines|url=t/star-wars-insider/us/143|text=''Star Wars Insider'' 143}}</ref>
